title: 18-Year-Old Learning Her Lesson The Hard Way
description:
On August 26th, 2022, an officer conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle with malfunctioning license plate lights. The driver complied and handed over his driver's license, which turned out to be invalid. The cop also noticed a female passenger in the vehicle. Soon, things were about to take a different turn for both of them. As soon as the female officer arrived on the scene, she grew suspicious about the vehicle’s condition and started investigating. The driver didn't have a valid license, and to make things worse, his passenger planned to give the police officer a fake name. It turned out that the fake name she gave had a warrant attached to it, and now she was going to face some serious problems. Usually, in such situations, people become anxious and take a combative approach towards the cops. They resist and obstruct their arrest in an attempt to escape. The young lady was about to make the same mistake. It was too late to apologize now; the female had already picked up a charge for concealing her identity, and she was now guilty of committing a petty misdemeanor. Being argumentative with the cops was only going to worsen the situation. Meanwhile, the driver remained calm and stayed in his vehicle, avoiding any inquiries or attempts to obstruct the passenger's arrest. However, the female showed no signs of calming down. The officers had already noticed the driver's calm behavior and knew that he wouldn't be difficult during the investigation. All of this was going to work in his favor. The female was going to apologize to the cop again, but she didn't realize it was already too late. The female was charged with concealing identity and resisting arrest.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
